findings.rationale: Sponsor uses USP 47 Reference Standard for Compound Alpha, lot number USP-CA-2024-R112. Certificate of analysis (CoA) submitted. Overlaid IR spectra of the reference standard and drug substance submitted confirming identity. Working standard WS-CA-LAB-007 qualified against the USP primary reference standard. Source of standards: purchased from United States Pharmacopeia. Impurity standard for Alpha-Impurity-1 characterised by IR and NMR spectroscopy; purity assigned at 98.6% and documented in the impurity standard CoA supplied by Sigma Reference Materials.
